Oṣadhālaṅkāra
med. lex. in Skt. an. Marathi. Bomb. Uni. 2320. See Auṣadhālaṁkāra. [Page096-b]

Oṣadhiº
see also auSadha an. auSadhiº

Oṣadhikalpalatikā
med. Ānandāśrama 4049. See below Auṣadhikalpalatā ascribed to Śiva.

Oṣadhigrahaṇavidhi
mantra. TD. XX. Sup. no. 1012 (t).

Oṣadhināmāni
med. names of med. herbs with Malayalam equivalents. GD. 1015. Granthappura p. 44 (no. 1015).

Oṣadhināmāvalī
med. lex. names of medicinal plants, in alphabetical order, by Rādhākṛṣṇa. Radh. 31.

Oṣadhinighaṇṭu
or gaNanighaNTu med. lex. by Candranandana, son of Ravinandana. See Cordier, J.. 1901. p. 185. Q. by Kṣīrasvāmin in his C. on Amarakośa. GD. 1016 (interspersed with Malayalam). Granthappura p. 44 (no. 1316). Oppert I. 971. See Gaṇanighaṇṭu.

Oṣadhinighaṇṭu
or madanavinodanighaNTu med. lex. composed in A. D. 1374 by Madanapāla who ruled over Kāmaṭhā on the Jumna a few miles north of Delhi. GD. 1017 (interspersed with Malayalam). Granthappura p. 44 (no. 1017) (inc.). See under Madanavinoda.

Oṣadhisūkta
Ṛv. X. 97. MD. 17166. Mysore D. I. 536. Oxf. 398a. Trav. Uni. 2363B.
